text: じょうたいいじょうを　ふせいで　くれるの

structure.jp: じょうたいいじょうを
ふせいで　くれるの

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form says someone does the thing as a favour for you. ふせいで くれる = 'prevents them for you'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, explaining tone, often in girls' speech. ふせいで くれるの = 'it prevents them for you, you see'.
